kind: Bounded verification scheduling and diagnostics only
scope: Only normal Lean/owned-audit failures and controlled Git source/template/tool repairs. Worktree identity, snapshot qualification, toolchain prerequisites or invalid strict-driver summaries fail closed and terminate. No external environment repair is attempted.
invariants: Do not fast-forward while a strict child process is alive.
Keep all existing driver acceptance predicates and immutable receipts unchanged.
Let the strict driver validate matching normal records, accepted owned audits and stock replay reuse.
Continue normal modules that were not started before a batch budget expired.
Suppress an old audit failure only after the current original strict snapshot, compilation and failed command/log bindings match.
Print native compiler failures even when an outer cache record is still marked PENDING_BATCH_POSTCHECK.
Stop and reap only process groups spawned by this supervisor, including an asynchronous deadline during process creation.
READY_FOR_EXPORT requires current strict success summaries for the 132+8 partition and every owner; it does not export or declare P2.1 acceptance.
